name: Sarah Jenkins
psychographics: Values time-saving hacks over luxury; believes cooking should be functional, not a hobby
current_solutions: Ocado grocery deliveries every two weeks; HelloFresh subscription paused; uses Airtasker for occasional deep cleaning
frustration: Ocado cancelled her 7pm Thursday slot two weeks in a row, leaving her with no dinner option after a 9pm finish at the office
decision_style: compares unit prices on a spreadsheet, but will splurge on premium meal kits if she has a rare free evening
voice: practical and clipped; uses bullet points when explaining food budgets; says 'honestly' constantly
